commands.review_summary:
The branch adds `error` handlers to the three Windows `taskkill.exe` spawns in `runCommandWithTimeout` so async taskkill start failures fall back to `child.kill("SIGKILL")`.

PR surface: Source +11. Total +11 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. for source-level reproduction: current main and the latest release show taskkill child spawns without `error` handlers, and Node documents failed spawns as `error` events rather than successful `spawn` events. No live Windows end-to-end run was performed in this read-only review. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/api/child_process.html))
